name: 80 - API - Process Communication Opt In and Opt Out - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS mobile,
        $3::TEXT AS action,
        NULLIF($4::TEXT, '') AS channel,
        $5::TEXT AS actor_name,
        $6::TEXT AS source_channel,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '') AS policy_version,
        NULLIF($8::TEXT, '') AS reason
),

patient_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        patient.id AS patient_id,
        patient.full_name,
        patient.mobile,
        request.*
    FROM request_data request
    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE
    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.clinic_id = clinic.id
       AND patient.mobile = request.mobile
    LIMIT 1
),

consent_target AS (
    SELECT
        context.*,
        CASE context.action
            WHEN 'opt_out_all'
                THEN 'contact'
            WHEN 'opt_in_contact'
                THEN 'contact'
            WHEN 'opt_out_marketing'
                THEN 'marketing_messages'
            WHEN 'opt_in_marketing'
                THEN 'marketing_messages'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS consent_type,

        CASE
            WHEN context.action IN (
                'opt_in_contact',
                'opt_in_marketing'
            )
                THEN 'granted'
            WHEN context.action IN (
                'opt_out_all',
                'opt_out_marketing'
            )
                THEN 'revoked'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS new_status

    FROM patient_context context
),

previous_consent AS (
    SELECT
        consent.status
    FROM patient_consents consent
    INNER JOIN consent_target target
        ON consent.clinic_id = target.clinic_id
       AND consent.patient_id = target.patient_id
       AND consent.consent_type = target.consent_type
    WHERE target.consent_type IS NOT NULL
    LIMIT 1
),

upserted_consent AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_consents (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_type,
        status,
        policy_version,
        source_channel,
        granted_at,
        revoked_at,
        last_actor,
        last_reason,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        target.clinic_id,
        target.patient_id,
        target.consent_type,
        target.new_status,
        target.policy_version,
        target.source_channel,
        CASE
            WHEN target.new_status = 'granted'
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN target.new_status = 'revoked'
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        target.actor_name,
        target.reason,
        NOW()
    FROM consent_target target
    WHERE target.consent_type IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_type
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        status = EXCLUDED.status,
        policy_version = EXCLUDED.policy_version,
        source_channel = EXCLUDED.source_channel,
        granted_at = CASE
            WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'granted'
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE patient_consents.granted_at
        END,
        revoked_at = CASE
            WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'revoked'
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        last_actor = EXCLUDED.last_actor,
        last_reason = EXCLUDED.last_reason,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

inserted_event AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_consent_events (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_id,
        consent_type,
        event_type,
        previous_status,
        new_status,
        actor_name,
        source_channel,
        policy_version,
        reason,
        event_payload
    )
    SELECT
        consent.clinic_id,
        consent.patient_id,
        consent.id,
        consent.consent_type,
        CASE
            WHEN consent.status = 'granted'
                THEN 'granted'
            ELSE 'revoked'
        END,
        (
            SELECT status
            FROM previous_consent
        ),
        consent.status,
        target.actor_name,
        target.source_channel,
        target.policy_version,
        target.reason,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'action',
                target.action
        )
    FROM upserted_consent consent
    CROSS JOIN consent_target target
    RETURNING id
),

disabled_all_channels AS (
    UPDATE patient_communication_preferences preference
    SET
        enabled = FALSE,
        updated_by = context.actor_name,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM patient_context context
    WHERE context.action = 'opt_out_all'
      AND preference.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
      AND preference.patient_id = context.patient_id
    RETURNING preference.*
),

upserted_channel AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_communication_preferences (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        channel,
        enabled,
        updated_by,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        context.patient_id,
        context.channel,
        context.action = 'enable_channel',
        context.actor_name,
        NOW()
    FROM patient_context context
    WHERE context.action IN (
        'disable_channel',
        'enable_channel'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        channel
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled,
        updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

channel_event AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_consent_events (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_type,
        event_type,
        actor_name,
        source_channel,
        reason,
        event_payload
    )
    SELECT
        preference.clinic_id,
        preference.patient_id,
        'contact',
        'preference_changed',
        context.actor_name,
        context.source_channel,
        context.reason,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'channel',
                preference.channel,
            'enabled',
                preference.enabled
        )
    FROM upserted_channel preference
    CROSS JOIN patient_context context
    RETURNING id
),

ensured_profile AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_profiles (
        patient_id
    )
    SELECT
        context.patient_id
    FROM patient_context context
    WHERE context.action IN (
        'opt_out_all',
        'opt_in_contact'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (patient_id)
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING patient_id
),

synced_profile AS (
    UPDATE patient_profiles profile
    SET
        consent_to_contact = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'opt_in_contact'
                THEN TRUE
            WHEN context.action = 'opt_out_all'
                THEN FALSE
            ELSE profile.consent_to_contact
        END,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM patient_context context
    WHERE profile.patient_id = context.patient_id
      AND context.action IN (
        'opt_out_all',
        'opt_in_contact'
      )
    RETURNING profile.patient_id
),

consent_list AS (
    SELECT
        consent.consent_type,
        consent.status,
        consent.policy_version,
        consent.granted_at,
        consent.revoked_at,
        consent.expires_at,
        consent.updated_at
    FROM patient_consents consent
    INNER JOIN patient_context context
        ON consent.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
       AND consent.patient_id = context.patient_id
    ORDER BY consent.consent_type
),

preference_list AS (
    SELECT
        preference.channel,
        preference.enabled,
        preference.preferred_language,
        preference.timezone,
        preference.quiet_hours_enabled,
        preference.quiet_hours_start,
        preference.quiet_hours_end,
        preference.updated_at
    FROM patient_communication_preferences preference
    INNER JOIN patient_context context
        ON preference.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
       AND preference.patient_id = context.patient_id
    ORDER BY preference.channel
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_context
        )
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_context
        )
            THEN 'patient_not_found'

        WHEN request.action = 'opt_out_all'
            THEN 'all_communications_opted_out'

        WHEN request.action = 'opt_out_marketing'
            THEN 'marketing_messages_opted_out'

        WHEN request.action = 'opt_in_contact'
            THEN 'contact_consent_granted'

        WHEN request.action = 'opt_in_marketing'
            THEN 'marketing_consent_granted'

        WHEN request.action = 'disable_channel'
            THEN 'communication_channel_disabled'

        WHEN request.action = 'enable_channel'
            THEN 'communication_channel_enabled'

        ELSE 'communication_consent_status_loaded'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT patient_id
        FROM patient_context
    ) AS patient_id,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                TO_JSONB(consent)
            )
            FROM consent_list consent
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS consents,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                TO_JSONB(preference)
            )
            FROM preference_list preference
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS preferences,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM inserted_event
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS consent_event_id,

    CASE
        WHEN request.action = 'opt_in_marketing'
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_consents consent
            INNER JOIN patient_context context
                ON consent.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
               AND consent.patient_id = context.patient_id
            WHERE consent.consent_type = 'contact'
              AND consent.status = 'granted'
         )
            THEN 'grant_contact_consent_first'
        ELSE 'none'
    END AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

return [{json:{success:false,result:'invalid_request',message:'اطلاعات تغییر وضعیت ارتباط نامعتبر است.',errors:$json.errors||[]}}];

## Opt-out ایمن و قطعی

تشخیص خودکار فقط برای توقف پیام انجام می‌شود.

فعال‌سازی مجدد باید با action صریح ارسال شود.

اقدام‌ها:
- opt_out_all
- opt_out_marketing
- opt_in_contact
- opt_in_marketing
- disable_channel
- enable_channel
- get_status
